subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects local government agencies in Navajo County and Apache County, Arizona, and federal Forest Service administration.
dimensions.evidence: convey certain lands within the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest to Navajo County and Apache County, Arizona

dimensions.assessment: Conveys approximately 5 acres for one county and roughly 8.17 acres for the other for local cemetery use.
dimensions.evidence: consisting of approximately 2.5 acres ... and approximately 2.5 acres

dimensions.assessment: Requires the counties to pay all associated costs of the conveyances, including surveys and environmental analyses, involving no direct federal expenditure.
dimensions.evidence: the County shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: Applies strictly to two specific local land parcels and local government entities.
dimensions.evidence: convey certain lands within the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest

dimensions.assessment: Permanent land conveyance with a reversionary clause if the property is used inconsistently with cemetery requirements.
dimensions.evidence: all right, title, and interest in and to the property shall revert to the United States

missing_information: Exact total monetary costs for surveys and environmental analyses are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Forest Service to convey specific small parcels of National Forest System land in Arizona to Navajo County and Apache County for use as cemeteries, with the counties covering all associated costs.
